mechanism: Sumatriptan is a 5-HT1B/1D agonist that can cause vasoconstriction and increase blood pressure, while varenicline's alpha4-beta2 nicotinic receptor agonism may potentiate cardiovascular effects and both drugs have CNS activity that could be additive.
action: Monitor blood pressure and cardiovascular symptoms; consider alternative smoking cessation therapy if patient requires frequent triptan use or has cardiovascular risk factors.
